## 🇬🇧 Thor Weather Card

Weather station card for Home Assistant – barometer with **Zambretti forecast**, temperature tiles, **wind rose** (frequency / speed / Beaufort), wind & gusts, sun & UV, **pollen**, rain, **records & climate stripes**, calendar heatmap, vegetation, degree days, ventilation & mould risk, garden water balance, night frost, biometeorology – plus notification blueprints.

**Install / update:** HACS → *Thor Weather Card* → update, then reload the browser (Ctrl+F5).
All options can be set in the visual card editor. Details: [README](https://github.com/muhkuh666/thor-weather-card#readme)

## 🇩🇪 Thor Weather Card

Wetterstations-Karte für Home Assistant – Barometer mit **Zambretti-Prognose**, Temperatur-Kacheln, **Windrose** (Häufigkeit / Geschwindigkeit / Beaufort), Wind & Böen, Sonne & UV, **Pollenflug**, Regen, **Rekorde & Klimastreifen**, Kalender-Heatmap, Vegetation, Gradtage, Lüften & Schimmelrisiko, Garten-Wasserbilanz, Nachtfrost, Biowetter – dazu Blueprints für Benachrichtigungen.

**Installieren / aktualisieren:** HACS → *Thor Weather Card* → aktualisieren, danach Browser neu laden (Strg+F5).
Alle Optionen sind im grafischen Karten-Editor einstellbar. Details: [Anleitung](https://github.com/muhkuh666/thor-weather-card/blob/main/README.de.md)
